About the Role:
The role is a Senior Product Controller for CFE and Cantor Fitzgerald APAC covering the Equities and Prime Brokerage businesses.
The Senior Product Controller is responsible for:
Daily P&L reporting
Monthly legal entity close bookings and balance sheet substantiation
Focus to AI/Automation, Excel building for enhanced analytical review
Both duties report into the Cantor Head of Product Control EMEA (London Office).
The Senior Product Controller will:
Prepare daily P&Ls for trading desks and lead on explanations of daily P&L movements.
Work collaboratively with the two other team controllers (London Office) completing daily and monthly control tasks.
Liaise with functional support groups (trade support, front office IT, operations etc), the US group reporting, front office traders and business management. The role requires the individual to interact with senior management in finance and the front office businesses.

Job description
We all know that great work deserves great compensation. But rewarding deserving professionals is becoming increasingly complex. The workforce is more demanding. There is a focus on transparency, not just at executive level but at the workforce level too. New jobs, with no pay precedent, are emerging all the time. And flatter structures and contingent workforces mean career paths are no longer clear. We understand the differing dynamics of compensation markets around the globe and in all sectors. We know current trends, how to create engaging employee value propositions, and have the right Total Rewards strategy. We develop flexible and competitive work architecture and compensation strategies that align employees and senior executives with the business strategy. And we build thoughtful employee engagement programs that attract and engage a diverse workforce and reinforce company culture and goals.
The Role
The Associate Principal work closely with colleagues to deliver complex, customized and multi work-stream solutions that meet and exceed client expectations. At this level, business development and client relationship management feature as an important focus of the role in addition to delivery. Principals contribute to bids and manage/lead relationships and/or projects of considerable complexity. Principals have developed a deep understanding to solve complex problems in the Pay Transparency area. Depending on the size of the project a principal will lead and manage client projects.
This role will focus on EU Pay transparency. Pay transparency means openly sharing how compensation decisions are made—this includes job grades, salary ranges, pay frameworks, and rationale behind pay. It aims to promote fairness, reduce pay gaps, and build trust across the organization.

Establishing ‘Equal Work’ frameworks:
deliver
job analysis and work measurement (job grading) projects (using the Korn Ferry Hay method for job evaluation)
to establish relative weight and nature of roles within organisations.

Analyzing and Communicating Pay Frameworks
: Support the development and disclosure of salary ranges, compensation principles, and decision-making processes.
Championing Fair Compensation
: Help implement transparent pay practices that ensure equity across roles, demographics, and regions.
Driving Compliance with Global Legislation
: Contribute to aligning work architecture and compensation strategies with evolving laws like the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
Supporting DE&I Goals
: Use pay transparency as a tool to advance diversity, equity, and inclusion across the organization.
Engaging a New Workforce Generation
: Collaborate with HR and leadership to meet expectations of Millennials and Gen Z for openness and fairness in pay.
Boosting Talent Attraction and Retention
: Help position the organization as a trusted, ethical employer through transparent work architectures and competitive compensation.
Building Trust and Accountability
: Foster a culture where employees understand and trust how their compensation is determined.

Building strong customer relations, typically works with clients across different sectors and countries.
Conducting complex product and services clients’ onboardings and training for Korn Ferry Talent Suite.
